status: Deployed and hardened Cloudflare Worker (version bf48e333 on Nov 19, 2026) running Vertex AI Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite on Evidence Version 4, verified by live smoke tests (docs/evidence/LIVE_SMOKE_2026-11-19.md). Local runs default to the deterministic fixture provider. Game-side boundary, validation, deadline and fallback are in src/overload/agent/. Needs one Worker redeploy for config/tactics.json version 3 and OAuth cold-start warm-up (POST /sessions/:id/warmup).
purpose: Choose the Regulator's protocol for the next encounter from the player's observed habits.
native_artifact: worker/src/index.ts routes GET /health, POST /sessions, POST /sessions/:id/warmup and POST /sessions/:id/tactic, worker/src/session.ts (RivalSession, a Cloudflare Agents SDK agent), structured JSON with strict schemas in worker/src/schema.ts
prohibited_actions: change stats, damage, health or speed
inspect hidden inventory, positions, RNG or raw world state
memory_policy: Last two encounter summaries for the current session only, each at most 300 tokens. Reset on a new session. Server state expires after 30 minutes of inactivity. No cross-session retrieval or shared memory.
context_sources: config/evidence.json (version 4: ten visible observation kinds, five power families)
config/tactics.json (version 3: tactic catalogue and power-family counter guidance)
previous accepted tactic and the last two summaries for this session only
retrieval: None. No RAG or external knowledge.

model_choice.provider: Vertex AI via Cloudflare Worker secret service-account credentials (decision D6)
model_choice.settings: temperature 0, structured JSON output, no automatic continuation, no retry
model_choice.resolved_model: Logged per request when the API returns it

named_failure_modes: wrong session, request or encounter ID
evaluation_cases: Deterministic: boundary invariance, two-session isolation, invalid proposal rejection, timeout, stale reply, request cap, ledger retry hardening, full win and loss paths. Live: six authored 10-kind Evidence Version 4 histories (eval/histories.json v2) x three repeats, at most 18 attempts and $1 per suite.
logging_policy: Anonymous session ID, encounter and request IDs, config and prompt hash, requested and resolved model, filtered-context hash, accepted proposal, fallback reason, latency, token and cost estimate. No credentials or participant identities.
human_override_points: Adit approves model, config and spending
Adit can disable live mode at launch, which uses the deterministic fallback
Adit can stop any live evaluation
Adit decides every change and merge
test_command: uv run pytest && (cd worker && npm test)
fallback: Any invalid, late, unavailable, disabled or over-budget proposal becomes lateral (Oscillate protocol), labeled as fallback in the trace. Combat never waits on the model.
knowledge_boundary: Only the observation-filter summary and the tactic catalogue cross to the model. Game code owns all state and validates every proposal.
limitations: config/tactics.json and config/evidence.json are bundled into the Worker at build time, so updates require a redeploy by Adit before live runs.
Fixture results are a deterministic rule and are labeled source fixture. They are never model evidence.
A fixed-schedule baseline tests history dependence, not whether an LLM beats a simple adaptive rule.
Valid JSON and real evidence IDs do not prove the chosen tactic was a good one.
